protocol: One post-change H run. New synthetic questions, not real-repository held-out accuracy. Do not tune on this set after its first call. Grade complete required lines, exact source quotes, and negative unresolved status separately. Distractors require manual relevance review.

questions.query: Where does submitInvoice call priceInvoice and return invoiceTotal, and how is billingPolicy taxRate configured and used in priceInvoice?
Where does dispatchParcel call sendParcel and return trackingCode, and how is deliveryPolicy retryLimit configured and used in sendParcel?
Where does submitInvoice call refundInvoice to reverse the invoice? Show the refundInvoice call.
Where does dispatchParcel call cancelParcel? Show the cancelParcel call and its implementation.
